decision.action: implement RED-first exact SWA local64 packed-dim2 reducer
decision.reason: The post-local32 traces leave the exact SWA value reducer at 1.468 ms/token short and 8.723-8.741 ms/token long. Unlike rejected GQA3, local64 dim2 preserves all 72 head workgroups while halving replicated softmax-state and packed-load instruction work without changing per-dimension arithmetic.

device_work_model.interpretation: This is a source-level instruction/work model, not a hardware-counter or throughput claim. Cache behavior, dual-accumulator register pressure, and reduced waves are decided only by actual-weight timing.

actual_weight_precondition.requirement: All F32/BF16 outputs remain byte-exact and candidate full score+reducer HIP-event and synchronized-wall medians improve at every layer/live row; remove the candidate on any failure.

after_actual_weight_pass_only: Default-off backend-qualified selector with the retained local128 wave-local reducer as exact registry fallback.
Sixteen-transition full logits/IDs, all 48 hidden and 47 routed boundaries, active K/V and every span field, reset/re-prefill, ownership, and lifecycle identity.
Cached rocprofv3 proof of 36 candidate calls/token at local64/grid4608 with unchanged 723 model kernels/token and no compiler under profiling.

Two process orders at short/512/1K/near-4K: target reducer improves everywhere; total kernel/span regressions stay below 0.5%; equal-process child throughput stays above -0.5%; IDs/resources/lifecycle pass.
Both complete 18-prompt process orders: pooled h16/h32 and every train/heldout category decode improve; E2E/prefill/TTFT/state/lifecycle guards pass before promotion.
codegen: local64 with wavefront size 32, grid X 4608, and exactly 72 query-head workgroups.
zero LDS, zero private segment, zero VGPR/SGPR spills, and scratch0.
No persistent copy, workspace, score-producer change, or prefill route.
primitive_correctness: F32 context and BF16 gated output byte identity versus the retained local128 wave-local reducer.
Normal and tile16 score scratch at live 65/70/127/128/256/257/511/512.
Reversed physical slots, SWA wrap, stale positions, sparse eviction, tied/extreme scores, invalid/empty spans, and denominator underflow.
Complete KVLiveSpans semantics remain owned by the unchanged score producer and scratch.
Packed BF16 low/high extraction is validated independently, including the final dimension pair.
frozen_gates.red: Add separately registered normal-score and tile16-score gfx1100 c=1 local64-dim2 wrappers/keys and a production reducer fixture before adding any runtime selector.

retained_trace.note: The immutable candidate traces are the exact default-off implementation later promoted unchanged; both process orders pass the retained ID, finite-logit, lifecycle, selector, resource, and 723-dispatch gates.

selection.arithmetic_contract: For every dimension, preserve the same visible logical slots, score scaling, max scan, expf and denominator order, slot-order FMA chain, denominator clamp/divide, F32 context store, FP32 softplus multiplication, and RNE BF16 gate store. Sharing one deterministic gate value and one packed source load across two dimensions changes no arithmetic association.
selection.candidate: exact SWA local64 packed-dim2 wave-local gated reducer
difference_from_other_closed_screens: Not Q5 output wave packing, heterogeneous IQ2/shared-Q5 ownership, or another mixed-projection owner.
Not online-softmax reassociation or the rejected max-barrier-only edit.
Not launch-count-only graph, packet, or native-AQL work.
difference_from_rejected_gqa3: Retains all 72 independent query-head workgroups instead of collapsing them to 24.
Keeps one head per workgroup instead of serializing three head states in one block.
Carries two adjacent dimensions for one head rather than reusing one value across different heads.
Does not claim a value-payload-byte reduction; the value source bytes and all per-dimension FMAs remain unchanged.
selection.ownership: One local64 workgroup still owns exactly one query head. Thread t owns adjacent dimensions 2*t and 2*t+1; wave 0 covers dimensions 0..63 and wave 1 covers 64..127. Each wave leader replays the retained scalar max and denominator order, and one aligned packed BF16 load supplies two independent per-dimension accumulators.
selection.scope: Only the c=1 split SWA value reducer; existing normal/tile16 score producers, score and physical scratch, raw BF16 KVLiveSpans, prefill, global attention, and all retained fallbacks remain unchanged.

selection_budget.interpretation: Closing the matched h32 gap from this family alone would require saving about 46% of its short-profile time. The source model removes half of replicated scalar/load instructions but not value bytes or FMAs, so no completion outcome is projected.

source_audit.current_contract: one local128 block per query head; four wave leaders independently replay max/denominator while one lane owns one dimension
